newsitem.title: USA: Standex sees improved sales in second half.
newsitem.headline: Standex sees improved sales in second half.

text.p: Standex International Corp said Tuesday it expects sales in the fiscal second half to improve from a year earlier, despite sluggishness in its European divisions.
The company said the European divisions had been hurt by slow economic conditions.
Although its food service group is improving, the company said, it still has not reached the levels it previously anticipated.

"We anticipate that the last half of the fiscal year will be an improvement over the comparative prior-year period, and that the year as a whole will be satisfactory," President and Chief Executive Edward Trainor said in a statement.
For the second quarter ended December 31 the company reported lower sales and earnings.
Standex is a diversified manufacturer in industrial products, graphics/mail order and institutional products.
